title: [Quality Management] Use Bin code selection for transfer disposition in workflow response
summary: Quality Management now uses selected bin codes when creating transfer orders for quality disposal workflows, improving the accuracy of goods disposition in warehouse operations.
key_points: Bin code selection is now applied when transferring items through quality disposition workflows
Transfer order creation now respects the selected bin information
Workflow response options extended to support bin code handling
Test coverage expanded for workflow scenarios with bin selection
quote: Use selected bin in disposition via Transfer Order.
